limitations: Exploratory controlled workload; sequential runs reduce but do not eliminate time/provider variation.
CI queue offsets are fixed simulation; actual tests run on immutable snapshots.
Exposure means the first provider payload containing the unique terminal result eventId, not retrieval time.
Post-exposure relevant source edit is linked to a passing tested snapshot; causality is not assumed.
Percent changes use PA as denominator and include only complete correct pairs; all other attempts remain present.
